name: The Heart
overview: Scripture reveals the heart as central to human life and relationship with God, described as both the source of life’s outcomes and deeply deceitful and wicked (Proverbs 4:23; Jeremiah 17:9). Believers are called to trust God wholeheartedly rather than rely on their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5), and to seek God’s renewal for a clean and steadfast heart (Psalms 51:10). The heart also reflects inner emotions, influencing one’s countenance and spirit, while its true nature is known only by God (Proverbs 15:13; Proverbs 27:19). This study emphasizes the need to soften and guard the heart in light of its condition and God’s transforming power.
